filename: T2 - Diffuse astrocytoma NOS frontal , basal ganglia 010.jpg
description:
left frontal intra-axial ill-defined mixed cystic solid tumor measuring about 3 x 6 x 7 cm displays high T2 signal, heterogeneous low T1 signal with ill-defined areas of enhancement

infiltration of basal ganglia and corpus callosum rostrum and genu segments

marked pressure effect upon the left frontal horn and midline shift to the right of 1.5 cm

subfalcine and uncal herniations

the anterior cerebral arteries abut the lesion and are displaced to the right

surrounding vasogenic edema

areas of diffusion restriction detected within the mass lesion

no remodeling of the overlying skull
